bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
echo '[WSL_MOUNT_STATUS]'
ls -ld /mnt /mnt/g /mnt/g/GserverStorage 2>&1 || true
echo '[DRIVE_ENTRIES]'
ls -la /mnt 2>&1 | head -35
echo '[MOUNT_FACTS]'
findmnt -rn -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE | grep -E '(/mnt|drvfs|9p)' | head -35 || true
echo '[DRVFS_SETTINGS]'
if test -f /etc/wsl.conf;then sed -n '1,100p' /etc/wsl.conf;else echo NO_WSL_CONF;fi
echo '[DISK_IDENTITIES]'
lsblk -o NAME,FSTYPE,LABEL,SIZE,MOUNTPOINTS | head -35 || true
echo '[TARGET_UNIT_STATUS]'
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p Result --no-pager || true
echo '[RESIDENT]'
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
echo '[END]'
